Third-party files in this folder

d3.min.js: D3 v7.9.0, ISC licence, https://d3js.org
topojson-client.min.js: topojson-client v3.1.0, ISC licence, https://github.com/topojson/topojson-client
countries-50m.json: world-atlas v2.0.2, ISC licence, derived from Natural Earth (public domain), https://github.com/topojson/world-atlas
ocha-icons/: OCHA Humanitarian Icons (public domain, UN OCHA), web-font packaging from @platyplus/humanitarian-icons v0.1.3, MIT licence, https://www.npmjs.com/package/@platyplus/humanitarian-icons
../flags/: country flags from flag-icons v7.6.0, MIT licence, https://github.com/lipis/flag-icons
